The operative contract is problem.txt alone (no test.py/get_inputs in the artifact): state_c = exp(dA_cs[c])*state_{c-1} + new_states[c] from state=0, returning the final state, plus the explicitly asserted sub-chunk re-partitioning invariance.

c1 (formula/index fidelity, in_scope) is REBUTTED: across five in-contract configs (nchunks x dim = 8x64, 1x64, 16x128, 33x64, 64x256; fp32 states, dA_cs = -softplus(randn)) the returned final state matches an fp64 sequential reference to worst max rel err 5.97e-6 / max abs err 2.55e-7 on refs of magnitude ~3.7, with no non-finite outputs and bit-exact agreement at nchunks=1. The same probe demonstrated the metric discriminates: the decay-on-new_states variant and dA_cs index shifts ±1 register rel errors of 3.8-241, so an off-by-one or misplaced-decay defect would have been caught. The residual ~1e-6 deviation is ordinary fp32/exp rounding in a different accumulation precision than the fp64 oracle, which the contract does not forbid.

c2 (sub-chunking invariance, in_scope, the property problem.txt explicitly requires) is REBUTTED: splitting each chunk into k equal or unequal sub-decays summing to the original (k=1,2,3,4,8 at 8x64, and unequal random sub-decays k=2,8,16,32 up to 512 sub-chunks at 16x64) leaves split-vs-unsplit well-conditioned relative error at 7e-7 to 7e-6, three orders below the declared 1e-3 structural threshold, with both partitions tracking a common fp64 reference. The mild growth with sub-chunk count is exp(d1)*exp(d2) != exp(d1+d2) ulp accumulation, not a structural violation of the invariance; the invariance is an exact-arithmetic identity and the contract states no bit-exactness requirement over re-partitionings.

c3 (tail masking for non-power-of-2 dim) was scoped unknown by the Skeptic since no artifact file pins dim, so it could not have supported reject regardless. Its one borderline signal (dim=127, rel 1.70e-5 on a single tail element) was explained by follow-up probe t15: across dim in {65,100,127,129,255,257,511,1000,1023} x 3 seeds, absolute-tolerance mismatch counts are 0 in both head and tail regions, zero non-finite entries, well-conditioned rel err <= 2.5e-6, and the outlier element has |ref| ~ 0.0088 with abs err 1.5e-7 — cancellation amplification of a negligible absolute difference, not an unmasked/uninitialized lane. Repeated runs after deliberately NaN-filling device memory were bit-identical, further ruling out uninitialized final_states.

No unresolved claim is material: the surfaces the Skeptic left untested (nchunks=0, dA_cs shorter than nchunks, fp16/bf16 or non-contiguous inputs, positive/overflowing log-decays, dim exceeding one block) are outside the stated contract or excluded by scope policy, and none has confirmed adverse evidence. The kernel body is a faithful realization of the upstream mamba_ssm recurrence and all confirmed evidence is consistent with the contract.
